content:
All signs indicate that Siri AI is about to land on HomePod through brand-new hardware. Leaker pdfu shared evidence today of what the new Siri looks like running on HomePod.

HomePod 27 code has added support for Siri AI and features a redesigned status indicator light.

Apple never talks about future products, but for months there have been widespread reports that Siri AI will be included in the upcoming new Apple TV 4K and HomePod devices.

When Apple unveiled Siri AI in June, it made no mention whatsoever of the assistant coming to tvOS or HomePod. Many speculated this was because the new Siri requires yet-to-be-announced brand-new hardware.

Leaker pdfu posted on X platform today, giving us a glimpse of how Siri AI might look running on HomePod. Below is the post and video:

As the post notes, the HomePod 27 software already contains the code needed for Siri AI — it just isn't enabled for users yet.

In a follow-up post, pdfu added that it remains unclear whether Siri AI will be limited to working only with new hardware, but that possibility seems almost certain.

If Apple intended to bring Siri AI to older HomePod models, in theory it should have announced that feature back in June. The company's complete silence on its Siri AI plans for home products strongly suggests strict hardware restrictions will be in place.

What do you think of the new Siri AI design on HomePod? Let us know in the comments.
